_comment: The ONE obligation the Kosli founder demo traces (docs/plans/kosli-founder-demo-briefing.md): a proposed Meridian Trust product obligation for the fictional Open Finance payment-initiation case. It is FICTIONAL PLANNING material — the source and article are Meridian's own internal policy reference, not a regulatory citation, and nothing here asserts what any regulation requires. run-demo.mjs --scenario meridian appends `obligation` to the adopted obligations register and the `register` blocks to the data-risk register, then registers `control` in the adopted control catalog with demo/meridian/payment-status-check.mjs as its mechanism. None of this touches the shipped templates.

obligation.article: MT-PAY-POL-2026 §4.3 Payment status integrity (fictional institutional policy, not a regulatory citation)
obligation.title: A payment-initiation timeout is never reported to the customer as a failed payment: the reference is preserved, the existing outcome is investigated by status query, and no retry is made until the outcome is known

taxonomy.definition: Risk that an indeterminate payment outcome (timeout, partial response) is reported or acted on as a terminal outcome, causing duplicate payments, false failure notices or unrecoverable references.

statement.statement: A payment-initiation call that times out is treated as failed and retried, so the customer may pay twice or be told a completed payment failed.

control.description: The payment-initiation service declares its timeout contract; scripts/payment-status-check.mjs refuses a contract that resolves a timeout to failed, drops the reference or retries before a status query, and requires recorded negative-test evidence.

conditions: status-contract gate green on every change to the service
runtime reconciliation evidence owed before production authorisation

control.objective: A payment-initiation timeout resolves to unknown, preserves the reference, and is never retried before a status query — declared by the service and evidenced by a recorded negative test
control.note: DEMO-SCOPED control registered by demo/run-demo.mjs --scenario meridian. Validates a declaration and a recorded test (PSI-R06); does not observe a payment system or the platform status API. Not in the shipped catalog template.
